title: Treats and Gifts to Share
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The people all were safe and free,
their tears were turned to joy;
They made a holiday, Purim,
for each small girl and boy.

[Chorus]
When Heavenly Father helps you,
be thankful, sing and share;
A gift, a smile, a little treat
makes joy grow everywhere.

[Verse 2]
They shared their yummy treats with friends,
gave presents, big and small;
They gave to those with little too,
so joy could reach them all.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and think of one
you'll share a smile with soon;
Heavenly Father's here with you,
beneath the quiet moon.

[Chorus]
mood: Dancing music. A light, skipping sway bounces under the voice, like children passing plates of treats around a happy table. The first two verses keep that bright, thankful bounce as gifts go from hand to hand. By the last verse the skip slows to a gentle rock, lower and softer, the party winding down under a quiet moon.
